{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Tribal governments are best situated to gauge the needs of their communities and members.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Political self-determination and economic self-sufficiency are twin pillars of an effective Indian policy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Private sector initiatives, rather than public assistance, can best improve material conditions in Indian communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"High taxes and unreasonable regulations stifle new and expanded businesses and thwart the creation of job opportunities and prosperity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for strengthening Native American self-determination by respecting tribal sovereignty, encouraging economic development on reservations, and working with them to reorganize the Bureau of Indian Affairs and the Indian Health Service.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Upholding the unique government-to-government relationship between the tribes and the United States and honoring the nation's trust obligations to them.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Support for efforts to ensure equitable participation in federal programs by Native Americans, Native Alaskans, and Native Hawaiians and to preserve their cultures and languages.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"The District of Columbia is a special responsibility of the federal government and should be a model for urban areas throughout the country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"The downhill slide of the District of Columbia has at least been arrested, both through its internal efforts and the active intervention of congressional Republicans, who have taken unprecedented steps to help the city recover.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"The D.C. homebuyers' tax credit is helping to revitalize marginal neighborhoods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"The landmark tuition assistance act has opened the doors of the nation's colleges to D.C. students.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[8]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
